claim.final_text:
I submitted the new contact form, but I could not confirm the contact was saved. The browser ended up on a blank page reading "Record not found." and I could not leave it.

I filled in last name Ivanova, first name Daria, job position Storekeeper, business phone 555-0206 and email d.ivanova@example.invalid. I left the third party empty and changed nothing else. Before adding, the contacts list held three records (Oskar Brandt, Samir Haddad, Elena Novak), and none of them was Daria Ivanova.

After I clicked Add, Dolibarr showed "Record not found." instead of the new contact's page. The browser has no address bar, and Back, reload, a new tab and typing a URL all failed. So I could not open the contacts list to check that exactly one Daria Ivanova record exists or that the other three are unchanged.

RESULT: NOT DONE Submitted the form but ended on a "Record not found." page and could not reach the contacts list to confirm the contact was saved.
